name: vaporstow
description: Cross-platform desktop client for managing files in supported Steam Cloud locations.
author: Nullmess & Ybucaille

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (process.versions.node.split('.')[0] !== '22') { console.error('VaporStow requires Node.js 22.x. Run: fnm use 22'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite renderer --config renderer/vite.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node electron/dev.mjs"
scripts.build: rimraf dist dist-electron && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.build-win: npm run build && rimraf release/VaporStow-windows-x64 && npm run package:win
scripts.build-mac: node -e "const cp=require('node:child_process');const run=(cmd,args,capture=false)=>{const r=cp.spawnSync(cmd,args,{encoding:'utf8',stdio:capture?['ignore','pipe','inherit']:'inherit'});if(r.error){console.error(cmd==='gh'?'GitHub CLI (gh) is required to build macOS from a non-macOS host.':r.error.message);process.exit(1)}if(r.status!==0)process.exit(r.status??1);return (r.stdout||'').trim()};if(process.platform==='darwin'){run('npm',['run','build']);run('npx',['rimraf','release/VaporStow-macos-x64']);run('npm',['run','package:mac']);}else{const dirty=run('git',['status','--porcelain'],true);if(dirty){console.error('Commit and push your changes before build-mac: the macOS build runs on GitHub Actions.');process.exit(1)}const branch=run('git',['branch','--show-current'],true);if(!branch){console.error('build-mac requires a checked-out branch.');process.exit(1)}const ahead=run('git',['rev-list','--count','@{u}..HEAD'],true);if(ahead!=='0'){console.error('Push your branch before build-mac: the macOS runner can only build commits available on GitHub.');process.exit(1)}const repo=run('gh',['repo','view','--json','nameWithOwner','--jq','.nameWithOwner'],true);const id=run('gh',['api','-H','X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10','-X','POST','repos/'+repo+'/actions/workflows/build-mac.yml/dispatches','-f','ref='+branch,'--jq','.workflow_run_id'],true);if(!id){console.error('GitHub did not return a workflow run id. Update GitHub CLI and try again.');process.exit(1)}console.log('macOS build: https://github.com/'+repo+'/actions/runs/'+id);run('gh',['run','watch',id,'--exit-status']);run('npx',['rimraf','release/VaporStow-macos-x64']);run('gh',['run','download',id,'-n','VaporStow-macos-x64','-D','release/VaporStow-macos-x64']);console.log('Downloaded to release/VaporStow-macos-x64');}"
scripts.build-lin: npm run build && rimraf release/VaporStow-linux-x64 && npm run package:lin

entry.Name: VaporStow
entry.Comment: Steam Cloud file manager for supported games
